items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Well thank you, Phil. ... Thank you Phil, and I guess you're king of tired too.

ctx.x: I just want to mention the title of the album that we've just been discussing, which is on the Fat Cat label, SCJ136,-- The title is a very appropriate one. It's "Maxine Sullivan, Queen of Song." And it has a delightful picture of you on the cover, too.
